budget_items.topic: Preliminary sewer design bids (Upland/Eastern Ave and White St.)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Four proposals for preliminary design were compared; Wright Pierce, the low bidder, was recommended and approved, and the cost would be included in the project if it goes forward.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission approved the Q2 Commitment by verbal vote.
budget_items.quote: q2 commitment of $266,302.46 - barb asked for a verbal approval for the q2 commitment.

budget_items.topic: Delinquent back payments from prior fiscal year
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Back payments due from the prior fiscal year total $30,000, less than in previous years.
budget_items.quote: barb replied there is $30,000 in back payments due, which was less than previous years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Annual grease trap fees were stated for the record, differing by trap type and compliance; the Business Manager confirmed fees had been waived for the last 2 years.
budget_items.quote: internal trap - $150 if compliant, $ 350 if non-compliant, external interceptor - $450 if compliant, $ 650 if non-compliant.

budget_items.quote: barb confirmed that all fees have been waived for the last 2 years by the commission.
